SELECT STUD_NO /*학번*/ , PARTY_ID /*구성원 ID*/ , REP_NM /*대표명*/ , ENG_NM /*영어명*/ , CHA_NM /*한자명*/ , GENDER_RCD /*성별코드([TMP001])*/ , SSN /*주민번호*/ , STUD_DIV_RCD /*학생구분코드([TMP002])*/ , DEPT_CD /*학사부서코드*/ , DAY_NIGHT_DIV_RCD /*주야간코드([TMP003])*/ , NAT_RCD /*국가코드([TMP004])*/ , ZIPCODE /*우편번호*/ , ADDR1 /*주소1*/ , ADDR2 /*주소2*/ , CLP_NO /*휴대전화번호*/ , AEN /*내선번호*/ , EMAIL /*이메일*/ , BANK_RCD /*은행코드([TMP005])*/ , ACCT_NO /*계좌번*/ , OWNER_NM /*소유명*/ , ATTC_FILE_NO /*파일순번*/ , STUD_NO AS KEY_VALUE /* 고유번호*/ , (SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CMN_TMP_REG_FEE FEE WHERE REG.STUD_NO = FEE.STUD_NO ) AS DTL_CNT FROM CMN_TMP_REG REG
AND ( REP_NM LIKE '%'||#{STUD_NO}||'%' OR STUD_NO LIKE '%'||#{STUD_NO}||'%' )

SELECT SCH_YEAR /*학년도*/ , SMT_RCD /*학기코드[TMP006]*/ , STUD_NO /*학번*/ , REG_CLS_RCD /*등록분류코드[TMP007]*/ , TO_CHAR(IFR_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS IFR_DT /*고지일자*/ , TO_CHAR(PAY_CLOSE_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS PAY_CLOSE_DT /*납입마감일자*/ , TO_CHAR(DIV_PAY_REQ_DT, 'YYYYMMDD') AS DIV_PAY_REQ_DT /*분납요청일자*/ , DIV_PAY_DESC /*분납내역*/ , DIV_PAY_TYPE_CD /*분납유형코드*/ , DIV_PAY_STAT_RCD /*분납상태코드[TMP008]*/ , DIV_PAY_NO /*분납번호*/ , BKG_PNT /*수강신청학점*/ , BKG_TIME /*수강신청시간*/ , REG_STUD_DIV_RCD /*등록생구분코드[TMP009]*/ , REMARK /*비고*/ , REF_KEY /*참조키*/ , SCH_YEAR || SMT_RCD || STUD_NO || REG_CLS_RCD AS KEY_VALUE /* 고유번호*/ FROM CMN_TMP_REG_FEE WHERE STUD_NO = #{STUD_NO}
